Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.view

Class VentanaPrincipal

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
co.edu.unbosque.view.VentanaPrincipal
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants
public class VentanaPrincipal extends JFrame
Class that represents the main window of the game "ADVANCE-WARS". This class is responsible for creating and managing the panels and graphical elements of the game's user interface.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio

    • verificarCapturaEdificio

      public boolean verificarCapturaEdificio(int x, int y, String equipo)
      Checks if a building at a given location can be captured by a unit from a specified team. The method checks adjacent panels (up, down, left, right) from the provided coordinates to determine if any building can be captured by the unit. If the building is neutral, it is captured and the team color is updated. The capturing unit gains experience upon successfully capturing the building.
      Parameters:
      x - The x-coordinate of the starting position to check.
      y - The y-coordinate of the starting position to check.
      equipo - The team attempting to capture the building (e.g., "rojo", "azul").
      unidadCapturadora - The unit attempting to capture the building. This unit gains experience if the capture is successful.

    • generarPartida3Players

      public void generarPartida3Players(int soldados1, int tanques1, int aviones1, int soldados2, int tanques2, int aviones2, int soldados3, int tanques3, int aviones3)
      Generates a game map for a three-player match. This method initializes the map, creates panels that represent the terrain, and places each player's units in the specified positions. Mountains, trees, and buildings are randomly generated on the map. The images of the map elements are selected according to the specified paths.
      Parameters:
      soldados1 - Number of soldiers for the red player.
      tanques1 - Number of tanks for the red player.
      aviones1 - Number of planes for the red player.
      soldados2 - Number of soldiers for the green player.
      tanques2 - Number of tanks for the green player.
      aviones2 - Number of planes for the green player.
      soldados3 - Number of soldiers for the blue player.
      tanques3 - Number of tanks for the blue player.
      aviones3 - Number of planes for the blue player.

    • imprimirAvionesAzules

      public void imprimirAvionesAzules(int cantidadAviones, String url)
      Prints blue planes on the map. This method places a specific number of planes in the corresponding row of the map, using the provided URL for the visual representation of the planes. The planes are placed from left to right in the specified row, in panels that are instances of PanelCampo.
      Parameters:
      cantidadAviones - the number of planes to print
      url - the URL of the plane image

    • moverSoldados

      public void moverSoldados(int x, int y, String url, int posicionSoldadoX, int posicionSoldadoY)
      Moves a soldier from one position to another on the map. This method moves a soldier from the specified position (posicionSoldadoX, posicionSoldadoY) to the new position (x, y) on the map. The provided URL is used for the visual representation of the soldier at the new position.
      Parameters:
      x - the new X coordinate of the soldier
      y - the new Y coordinate of the soldier
      url - the URL of the soldier image
      posicionSoldadoX - the current X coordinate of the soldier
      posicionSoldadoY - the current Y coordinate of the soldier

    • actualizarApuntador

      public void actualizarApuntador()
      Updates the pointer on the map. This method sets the state of the pointer across all panels on the map, ensuring that only the panel at the pointer's position is activated. repaint() is called at the end to reflect the changes visually.

    • esEsquina

      public boolean esEsquina(int f, int c)
      Checks if a specific position is a corner of the map. This method determines if the coordinates (f, c) correspond to a corner of the map. The corners are defined as the positions (0, 0), (0, last column), (last row, 0), and (last row, last column).
      Parameters:
      f - the row to check
      c - the column to check
      Returns:
      true if the position is a corner, false otherwise

    • generarRios

      public void generarRios(int cantidadRios)
      Generates a specific number of rivers on the map. This method places rivers in random positions on the map, ensuring that they do not overlap with other rivers or buildings. A random number generator is used to determine the location of the rivers.
      Parameters:
      cantidadRios - the number of rivers to generate
